summary: Backend-only verification of Stripe-hosted email receipts enablement in billing.py. 12/12 pytest cases pass (100%). Verified: (1) POST /api/billing/checkout plan=monthly → 200 with cs_test_... Stripe-hosted URL; (2) plan=yearly → 200, distinct session_id; (3) retrieved the created Checkout Session via Stripe SDK and confirmed billing_address_collection='auto', mode='subscription', top-level metadata preserves device_id/user_id/plan, client_reference_id==device_id, allow_promotion_codes=true (NOTE: subscription_data.metadata is a Stripe write-only create param and is not surfaced on Session.retrieve() until the Subscription materializes post-payment — this is expected Stripe behavior, not a bug; metadata preservation is proven via top-level session.metadata which Stripe does surface); (4) regression — /api/analyze mode=text, /api/transcribe multipart, /api/history POST+GET with X-Device-Id, /api/auth/apple + /api/auth/google invalid tokens → 4xx, /api/billing/status unknown device → 'inactive', /api/billing/verify bogus session_id → 404 all pass. No 502 regression after billing_address_collection + description changes.
critical_code_review_comments: billing.py:210 comment correctly documents why customer_creation='always' was removed (payment-mode only). The subscription-mode auto-Customer-creation covers the receipt-email requirement.

Non-blocking: /tmp/test.wav referenced in the review request does not exist on this container; the test synthesizes a minimal valid WAV header inline instead, which exercises the same multipart upload code path. If a canonical reusable wav is wanted, main agent should drop one at /tmp/test.wav.

Loads /app/backend/.env to obtain STRIPE_SECRET_KEY for retrieval.
seed_data_creation: Transient Stripe test-mode Checkout Sessions were created during the run (cs_test_...). These are abandoned (never completed) and auto-expire in Stripe sandbox.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe checkout param changes verified end-to-end. billing_address_collection='auto' confirmed on live sandbox sessions. subscription_data.description/metadata are write-only on create and will only be inspectable on the eventual Subscription object post-payment — not a defect. The Stripe Dashboard toggle Settings → Emails → 'Successful payments' must be enabled manually by the user for Stripe to actually email receipts; this is NOT testable from the API side. For next iteration, if you need to end-to-end validate receipt emailing, you must use Stripe's test clock or a manual stripe listen + card test flow.
